prompt: Create a polished realistic illustrated miniature for our scientific chart. Soft studio key from screen UPPER LEFT/NW, smoothly darker lower-right, enough fill to read whole silhouette. Restrained natural palette and fine readable detail. Artist interpretation of TRAPPIST-1 e: rocky planet, muted dark oceans, rusty land and pale thin cloud wisps, thin atmosphere, subtle deep red-orange illumination. No Earth continent shapes. Reference white sphere controls shading exactly, not surface color.
note: Interpretive illustration. Mission photos constrain observed shapes; unresolved and unlit detail is inferred. Exoplanets and Psyche are artist interpretations, not resolved photographs.
